Michelle (CS): Heads-up — Cerulean reserved pool bring-up next Wed 09:00 PST. I sketched a "traffic primer" + chaos-proofing run. Need: quota confirmation, autoscale params, a 2h load-test window, and runbook owners.
Sanjay (Eng): +1. What GPUs & total vcores are we committing? need headroom numbers to shape the RPS curve.
Lia (PM): FYI I'll coordinate customer enablement and collect signed AUP. Also flagging renewal touchpoint in 30d (we should capture any perf concerns).
Omar (Infra): Right now cluster=cerulean-prod, nodes=8xA10G (approx). Rough capacity: ~350 concurrent tokens/sec at p95. Propose autoscale: min=2 pods, max=40 pods, target_cpu=65.
Sanjay (Eng): Can we get a short priming step for KV cache? If we blast from zero we'll see cold-KV tail. I'd do a 10m prefix-warm phase at 25% load.
Michelle (CS): Good call — include a warm phase. Customer wants realistic prompt mix (50% long chat, 30% short completions, 20% embeddings).
Omar (Infra): Draft autoscale policy (will apply to the reserved pool):
```
policy: autoscale
  target: cpu_utilization_percent: 65
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 40
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  surge_protection: true
```
I'll push this to staging and run a smoke.
Sanjay (Eng): Load-test plan (suggested):
1) 10m prefix-warm @ 250 RPS
2) 20m ramp 250 -> 1,500 RPS linear
3) 20m sustain @ 1,500 RPS with randomized prompt lengths
4) 10m cool-down
Script: `loadrun --profile cerulean-primer --ramp 20m --sustain 20m`
Michelle (CS): Proposed window: Wed 09:00-11:00 PST. Ops will gate start, CS will monitor account health dashboard and take notes for customer.
Lia (PM): Add me to the alerting list and ensure transcripts are saved to the enablement folder. Also will collect customer feedback via short survey right after the test.
ops-bot: Scheduled job created: `loadrun-cerulean-2712345678` at 2712345678 + 604800 (one week) — state: queued.
Omar (Infra): Before full ramp I'll run a quick `rdwctl capacity show cerulean` smoke and verify quotas: quotas look good but we'll bump token_limit per-second to 2x expected peak just in case.
Sanjay (Eng): Reminder: put LRU cache warmers into the script, and set KV cache TTL low during test to exercise refills.
Michelle (CS): Checklist for go/no-go (short):
- Quotas validated by infra 
- Autoscale policy applied to staging 
- Warm-phase script committed to repo 
- Customer enablement invite + survey ready 
- Oncall infra tagged (@oncall-infra)
If any item fails, postpone by 24h.
Lia (PM): I'll take owner of survey and customer comms. @Sanjay please share final load script by EOD Mon.
Sanjay (Eng): Will do — pushing a branch `cerulean-primer` with scripts and prompt sets.
Omar (Infra): I'll tag @oncall-infra at test start and watch the autoscale reactions. If we hit sustained 90% utilization across pods, we flip to fallback policy (route to hosted fallback model).
Michelle (CS): Perfect. If all good, we'll run post-test retro and capture any regression tickets for Optimize recommendations. :rocket:
Sanjay (Eng): Ack.
Lia (PM): Ack.
Omar (Infra): Ack.
